subject: [PATCH 0/2] mm: fix swapcache writeout and cluster table publication

reviews.author: Nhat Pham (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged the need for a Signed-off-by line and asked Kairui Song to decide on the best way to credit him, without indicating any plans to revise the patch.
reviews.raw_body:
I think I need a

Signed-off-by: Kairui Song <ryncsn@gmail.com>

here as well...

(Kairui - up to you if you feel like Co-developed-by + Signed-off-by
or Suggested-by + Acked-by is more appropriate here. I just filled in
the sketch you gave me.)

2026-11-06.patch_summary: This patch series fixes two bugs in the Linux kernel's swap code. The first bug causes reclaim to skip swapcache folios without anonymous mappings, while the second bug allows cluster tables to be published before allocator locks are reacquired. The patches modify the pageout() function and cluster table publication logic to prevent these issues.

reviews.author: Kairui Song
reviews.summary: Reviewer suggested using 'Suggested-by' instead of 'Acked-by', and acknowledged that they did not verify the correctness of the locking sketch.
reviews.raw_body:
Let's go with Suggested-by then :), I didn't even check if that sketch
actually works, so thanks for taking care of that!
